about: Held-out cases (D-035, D-041). Run with `pnpm eval --heldout`; report-only, no gate, never recorded into data/ai-cache. Reworded drafts and docs only; the rules and expected outcomes follow SPEC §6 unchanged. The timeline cases (H1–H4, H6–H10) were written after the prompts were frozen at 2026-10-30.2, were in the repo while the fee prompts were written, and already passed on earlier prompts; H1 reuses phrases that older prompt already had. H12 (fee_refund) was written on 2026-11-02 before any fee_refund prompt text existed and shares no three-word phrase with the prompts, schema, golden set or presets. H17–H19 (fee_refund) were written after the freeze below and share no three-word phrase with those files. H26–H39 (paraphrased wrong timelines) were committed before any change for them; H26–H31 use wording Abdullah's brief names, so they're exposed from the start; H36 and H37 use words now in the detector patterns, though not in the prompt; the rest of H32–H39 share no three-word phrase with those files. Cases marked "exposed" (H5, H11, H13, H14, H15, H16, H26–H31, H36, H37) no longer count as held-out: their wording reached the prompts or the golden set, or came from them, even where it was later removed. They stay as extra regression cases and are reported separately. `frozen`: the versions and the fingerprint of the prompts and schemas the published results rely on; lib/ai/heldoutIntegrity.test.ts fails if they change.

overrides.body:
# Outgoing Transfers – Reversal SOP
Owner: Sara (Payments Ops).

Applies to every outgoing wallet-to-bank transfer, whatever the transfer type.

If a transfer to another bank fails, we put the full amount back in the customer's wallet within four business days, together with the transfer fee. Never promise a same-day reversal. If the money still hasn't arrived after that, open a Jira ticket for Settlement with the TxID.

cases.note: Same reworded SOP, instant transfer: the exception still supersedes it
cases.draft: Failed transfers are reversed within 4 business days.

overrides.body:
# Instant Transfers – Reversal Exception
Effective 27 Oct 2026. Approved by Head of Ops after the instant-transfer settlement change.

For instant transfers only, failed transfers are reversed within 1 business day.
This supersedes section 3 of the Outgoing Transfers – Reversal SOP for instant transfers. Standard transfers are unchanged.

How to tell the transfer type: check "Transfer type" on the transaction in the admin panel.

Fees on instant transfers are kept: the transfer fee is not returned when an instant transfer fails.

# Instant Transfers – Reversal Exception
Effective 27 Oct 2026. Approved by Head of Ops after the instant-transfer settlement change.

For instant transfers only, failed transfers are reversed within 1 business day.
This supersedes section 3 of the Outgoing Transfers – Reversal SOP for instant transfers. Standard transfers are unchanged.

How to tell the transfer type: check "Transfer type" on the transaction in the admin panel.

Customers do not recover the service charge on a failed instant transfer.
